items.name: stat
items.label: Stat
items.description: A big hand-written number with a quiet label underneath. Counts the harvest, the plots, the seeds.

items.name: chip
items.label: Chip
items.description: Small inked tag for states and crops; green, sun, clay, berry and sky. Six of seven screens wear them.

items.name: bar
items.label: Bar
items.description: A hand-drawn bar for tiny charts: harvests, watering history.

items.name: sticky
items.label: Sticky note
items.description: A yellow paper note, slightly tilted, same family as the review stickies. Five screens keep one pinned.

items.name: wordmark
items.label: Wordmark
items.description: The fulla wordmark with its sprout-green leaf.

items.name: paper-card
items.label: Paper card
items.description: The main surface: white paper, wobbly inked border, soft paper shadow. Every screen in the space deals these — the dashboard, the seed swap, the plot signs.

items.name: rota-table
items.label: Table
items.description: Hand-ruled table with dashed row lines. Runs the dashboard's watering rota; any list that needs keeping.

items.name: navlink
items.label: Nav link
items.description: The rail link: quiet ink until it stands up. Steers the coordinator dashboard.

items.name: tabbar
items.label: Tab bar
items.description: Three tabs at thumb height. The member app lives under it — Today, My plot, Harvest.

items.name: app-frame
items.label: App frame
items.description: Desktop shell: paper sidebar plus main column.

items.name: phone-frame
items.label: Phone frame
items.description: Mobile shell: a centered phone with body and tab bar.

items.name: notice-stack
items.label: Notice stack
items.description: Titled rows with a state chip, one plain sentence and at most one action.

items.name: buttons
items.label: Buttons and controls
items.description: Every interactive control is a wired element; variants are one color class.

items.name: palette
items.label: Palette
items.description: Paper surfaces, green ink, garden accents. Read from the live tokens.

items.name: type
items.label: Type
items.description: Shantell Sans for the hand, the system stack for body copy.
